🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive, narrow/weak. Confirmations include VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.69% | 1M: +27.80%) and SPY/TLT ratio BELOW TREND (1W: -3.10% | 1M: -6.84%), with HYG/LQD also falling.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear is INCREASING: VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.69% | 1M: +27.80%). Credit stress is RISING: HYG/LQD ratio ↓ (1W: -0.90% | 1M: -0.89%), BELOW TREND; stocks are lagging bonds, with SPY/TLT ratio ↓ (1W: -3.10% | 1M: -6.84%), BELOW TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Dollar modestly firm: UUP ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.30% | 1M: +2.14%). Yield-curve indicator ↑ (1W: +1.30% | 1M: -0.21%), RECOVERY; TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.44% | 1M: +0.19%), while the dollar’s strength and rising volatility keep conditions cautious.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Defensive relative resilience: XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +4.46%); XLY is also ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.53% | 1M: +3.03%). Tech is weakest: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -3.78% | 1M: -15.69%); XLF is in CORRECTION (1W: -1.68% | 1M: +0.16%). Style: Value over Growth, though sector breadth remains narrow at 3/11.

5. US vs Global?
US equities are weak: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.86% | 1M: -6.09%). Relative regional measures favor Europe over the US, with Europe/US ratio ↑ (1W: +0.32% | 1M: +4.30%), ABOVE TREND; India leads EM, with India/EM ratio ↑ (1W: +4.64% | 1M: +24.44%), ABOVE TREND. EM is lagging: EEM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.71% | 1M: -8.30%).

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculative appetite is contracting: ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -4.77% | 1M: -17.57%) and IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -6.59% | 1M: -25.34%). Small caps are holding up relatively better but remain weak: IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -3.56%).

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Broad commodity weakness: CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -9.70% | 1M: -17.49%) and GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -7.67% | 1M: -11.52%). Agricultural relative strength is firmer: agriculture/market ratio ↑ (1W: +2.60% | 1M: +2.70%), ABOVE TREND.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy remains weak: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -4.59% | 1M: -13.20%) and BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -2.05% | 1M: -17.58%). Natural gas is an exception: UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.79% | 1M: +7.95%).

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed downside in SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.86% | 1M: -6.09%), XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -3.78% | 1M: -15.69%) and VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.69% | 1M: +27.80%). Major cross-timeframe divergence is absent across the core ETFs; XLF is a notable shorter-term pullback, in CORRECTION (1W: -1.68% | 1M: +0.16%).

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor quality and defensive resilience over high-beta exposure while breadth is 3/11; XLP is ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +4.46%). Reduce exposure to technology and speculative assets: XLK is BELOW TREND (1W: -3.78% | 1M: -15.69%) and ARKK is BELOW TREND (1W: -4.77% | 1M: -17.57%).

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: If breadth improves and volatility eases, monitor XLP, currently ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +4.46%).
BEARISH: If breadth remains at 3/11 or deteriorates, watch XLK, currently BELOW TREND (1W: -3.78% | 1M: -15.69%).

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: If natural-gas strength persists, monitor UNG, currently ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.79% | 1M: +7.95%).
BEARISH: If industrial demand signals weaken further, watch CPER, currently BELOW TREND (1W: -9.70% | 1M: -17.49%).

13. Key Levels?
Monitor VXX at 23.4000, with VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.69% | 1M: +27.80%); HYG/LQD at 0.7364, ↓ (1W: -0.90% | 1M: -0.89%), BELOW TREND; and XLK/XLF at 2.7997, ↓ (1W: -3.57% | 1M: -17.44%), BELOW TREND.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, with Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive, narrow/weak. Defensive resilience is concentrated in XLP, ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +4.46%), while Value is holding up relative to Growth. Monitor rising fear in VXX, ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.69% | 1M: +27.80%), and continued weakness in XLK, BELOW TREND (1W: -3.78% | 1M: -15.69%).
